# GREETING CARD

# 1.Materials used:

* Aluminium foil  
* LED Light  
* 3V Coin cell battery  
* Colour sheets  
* Glue  
* Scissors

# 2.Description:

#                      A Creative Greeting card made by combining paper craft with a simple LED lighting effect.

# 3.How we made it:

                                       
                                           First we prepared a card using chart paper and decorated with a colour [sheets.We](http://sheets.We) made 3D papers strip and added heart shaped designs .Aluminium foil was used to make the electrical connection between the LED and the 3V coin cell battery ,which makes the LED glow. Finally we decorated the card with colour sheets.  
 ![][image1]![][image2]

# 4.Working principle:

                                           
                                           The coin cell provides electrical energy to LED.When they are properly connected the LED glows and produce a light 

# 5.Conclusion:

                                     We successfully made an attractive LED greeting card using simple materials.This activity help us learn the basic working of LED and Battery while improving our creativity and practical skills.
